source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.8.3, printed pages 15-16, with Quick Check 1.4 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Chlorine dono metals se react kar ke soluble salts (pani mein hal hone wale salts) banati hai. Sodium ke saath reaction mein heat nikalti hai (exothermic), golden yellow flame nazar aati hai aur safed solid sodium chloride banta hai. Magnesium bhi chlorine se react kar ke safed solid magnesium chloride banata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Na aur Mg ke oxides aur hydroxides ki nature (fitrat) kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono ke oxides (Na₂O, MgO) aur hydroxides (NaOH, Mg(OH)₂) basic hain: yeh acids se react kar ke salt aur pani banate hain. NaOH ek strong alkali hai; Mg(OH)₂ kam hal hota hai aur weak base hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Group 2 ka element Ca pani aur oxygen se react kare to us ki reactivity ke bare mein kya andaza lagayenge?
blocks.explanation: Calcium group 2 mein magnesium ke neeche hai, is liye zyada metallic aur zyada reactive hai. Yeh thande pani se hi magnesium se zyada asani se react kar ke calcium hydroxide aur hydrogen deta hai, aur oxygen mein jal kar basic oxide CaO banata hai.

items: Chlorine dono metals se safed solid chlorides deti hai: 2Na + Cl₂ → 2NaCl (golden yellow flame, exothermic); Mg + Cl₂ → MgCl₂.
